units.function: Focused tests for bounded Issue-local continuation Markdown that carries objective, acceptance criteria, recent Run actions/errors, commands, blockers/decisions and a next action across adapter session resets.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> issue-continuation-summary pure helpers -> Issue, Run and Agent-shaped inputs; no database, route, adapter or external service is exercised.
units.keyDataModels: Issue identity/description/status/priority; Run identity/status/error/errorCode/result summary/output/finish time; Agent identity/name/adapter type; bounded Markdown body and parsed Next Action.
units.lifecycle: Collect latest Issue/Run/Agent context -> render bounded Markdown checkpoint -> attach it to later wake/context -> parse Next Action prose to decide whether executor work is parked for review.
units.testAssessment: Sandboxed focused Vitest passed 4/4. Tests cover required sections, success/error synthesis, maximum body length and two parking examples, but omit truncation precedence, hostile/untrusted text, secret/PII redaction, localization, provenance, stale checkpoints, multiple Runs, authorization and property/fuzz cases.
units.designRationale: Preserve enough Issue-local state for an Agent to continue after an adapter session reset without depending on a vendor-private session transcript.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs portable, vendor-neutral work checkpoints so humans and replacement Agents can understand what happened, what evidence exists, who remains responsible and what explicit action is next without importing private reasoning or credentials.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the bounded Issue-local checkpoint and vendor-session independence. Replace control decisions inferred from Markdown with a typed ContinuationCheckpoint containing source Run, responsible human, goal/contract version, completed actions, evidence references, blockers, next command, required approval, redaction result, creation reason and supersession lineage; render Markdown only as a projection.
units.responsibilityConflict: A natural-language sentence currently determines whether execution is parked, while Run summaries/errors may be untrusted Agent output. Without typed authority, provenance and redaction, prose can accidentally or maliciously change control behavior and cannot establish an accountable handoff.

units.securityFindings: HIGH control/prose coupling: parking is inferred from mutable natural language. HIGH secret/PII gap: Run error/result text enters the summary with no redaction test. MEDIUM provenance gap: rendered text does not itself prove sources, actor or responsible human. MEDIUM truncation gap: only total length is asserted, not preservation of safety-critical sections. MEDIUM injection gap: hostile Markdown/control phrasing is untested. POSITIVE: context is Issue-local, bounded and independent of vendor-private sessions.
